description.value: Frequency Sound 528 is a female-owned recording studio and cafe in East Kelowna, purchased in 2022 by co-owners Jodie Bruce, Lynn Anderson, and Rachel Gieck from the former Frequency Winery (as featured on Netflix). The venue combines a working analog and digital recording studio, a rehearsal room available around the clock, a podcast studio, and a cafe — all under one roof with a rooftop patio described as having one of the most spectacular views in East Kelowna. The space hosts regular live concerts, open mic nights, and storytelling events, and accepts Bitcoin Lightning payments.
